name: Frigorific-Fjard
description: Sand owns this world, in colors from bone-white to burnt sienna, migrating with the seasons before a patient wind. Where the gusts strip it away, a tidally locked hemisphere emerge like the bones of the planet.
Toxic air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
